# BDiff

> Browser-based diff viewer for comparing text and files. All processing happens locally — no data is sent to any server.

BDiff is a privacy-first file comparison tool built with React and TypeScript. It runs entirely in the browser with no server-side processing. Users can paste text directly or drag-and-drop files to instantly see differences with character-level highlighting.

## Features

- Two view modes: Side-by-side and Unified
- Character-level diff highlighting within changed lines
- GitHub-style context collapsing (show only lines around changes, expandable)
- Comparison options: ignore case, ignore whitespace, sort lines, ignore trailing newlines
- Export to HTML, Markdown, or Plain Text
- 8 languages: Japanese, English, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, French, German
- URL-based language routing (e.g. /en/, /ja/, /ko/)
- Drag-and-drop file upload
- Statistics: additions, deletions, changes, similarity percentage
- Fully responsive design

## Links

- [Live Site](https://bdiff.v41.me): The production BDiff application
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/rengotaku/bdiff): Source code and issue tracker
- [About Page](https://bdiff.v41.me/ja/about): Feature overview and privacy information

## Tech Stack

- React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS 3.4
- i18next for internationalization
- Myers diff algorithm for accurate diff detection
- Hosted on Cloudflare Pages
